assertions.assertion: presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease and nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to correlate these transient symptoms with potential arrhythmic events or ischemic changes that may not be captured on standard ambulatory monitoring
the required precertification or prior authorization (Reason Code CO-197) was not obtained before services were rendered
this appeal requests review of the authorization status and the clinical basis for medical necessity
